name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that jumps straight to the main content. This fixes the biggest keyboard navigation pain point—users can bypass repetitive navigation blocks in one keystroke. The trade-off is a tiny extra markup cost, but it’s negligible compared to the universal benefit.

name: Reader
text: The skip link still fails if JavaScript loads late—users tab into a broken page and hit dead space. A server-rendered skip link with a real href="#main" and CSS to hide it until focus fixes the race, no JavaScript needed. Ship both versions behind a flag; measure tab-focus time to settle it.
